svg.title: Kiro’s Night Shift — Cowboys vs. Wizards
svg.desc: An original isometric frontier arena. Kiro's Cautious Sheriff and Reckless Wizard each write a playbook. The referee plays 8 deals from both starting seats. The Sheriff wins 13 games and the Wizard wins 3. All 54 choices in the seed 0 replay are verified. In separate workflows a reviewer tests Dusty Pete, and Billy's proposed attack change goes to Alex and Fable. Cowboy wins in a later 100,000-duel bot audit move from 59.792% to 51.920%. The release reviewer runs Node and Chrome on a matching commit and refuses a different commit before testing. The guide linked in the README gives commands and evidence for the Outrider hook, installed Duel Review Power, Night Watch Crew and independent Python rules audit.
